preBuildReview.soundness: Combined source reviewed before building; relay-only login removal, audio routing, async chat history, account actions and bounded update-note scrolling are covered. Existing certificate, lineage and update key are retained.
preBuildReview.legalCover: Android parity reviewed against the existing position. Privacy 4.5 names the version, one-allocation check and absence of a web-app identifier. No publisher-run relay, directory, operator list or telemetry is added.
